patterns.note: Full-bleed hero sections, both static image and auto-playing video, create an immersive and editorial visual experience.
Product displays are organized into a consistent three-column grid, emphasizing visual presentation over dense information.
The sticky header dynamically samples the underlying content for its background, transitioning from transparent to a semi-transparent dark overlay as the page scrolls.
A persistent newsletter signup form remains fixed at the bottom of the viewport, sliding up from the bottom on initial load and staying visible.
A minimalist UI color palette of black, white, and grey allows the vibrant and diverse product photography to be the primary source of color and visual interest.
Navigation links and key labels consistently use a clean, uppercase sans-serif font, contributing to a sophisticated and modern editorial aesthetic.

technique_notes: A sticky header bar maintains its position at the top of the viewport, transitioning its background from transparent to a semi-transparent dark overlay that visually integrates with the content scrolling beneath it.
Hero sections utilize full-bleed imagery and auto-playing video to create immersive visual introductions, with the video hero featuring integrated playback controls.
Product displays are structured in a responsive grid, presenting items with consistent spacing and minimal descriptive text to emphasize the visual appeal of the garments.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced type scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, and navigation/labels use smaller, uppercase text for a refined look.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, particularly in hero sections and around product images, creating a sense of luxury and focus on individual items.

standout: The site's standout feature is its dynamic sticky header, which intelligently samples the background color/texture of the content scrolling beneath it, creating a seamless and context-aware visual integration. This, combined with the persistent newsletter popup and the high-quality video hero, elevates the site beyond a generic template into a distinctive editorial fashion experience.
